install_steps: TAG=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/mostlygeek/llama-swap/releases/latest | grep -oP '"tag_name":\s*"v\K[0-9]+') && curl -sL "https://github.com/mostlygeek/llama-swap/releases/latest/download/llama-swap_${TAG}_linux_amd64.tar.gz" | tar xz llama-swap && mv llama-swap ~/.local/bin/
note: Also via Homebrew (brew install llama-swap) or Docker (ghcr.io/mostlygeek/llama-swap — 'unified-cuda13'/'unified-vulkan' images bundle llama-server, whisper.cpp, sd.cpp, audio.cpp). Assets are named llama-swap_<ver>_linux_amd64.tar.gz where <ver> is the tag without 'v'. Flags use single-dash: -version, -config, -listen, -watch-config.
